name: Servatius Birkenmayer
bioAdditions: Two later Munzingen entries describe him after his death in the same way. In 1862 he is 'the late citizen and joiner (Schreiner) Servatius Birkenmaier', father of Maria Anna (S1). In 1867 he is 'the late citizen and joiner Servaz Birkenmaier', husband of the widow Agatha (S2). Neither entry adds a date.

sources.supports: Described as late joiner and citizen

searchedNoResult: His 1806/1807 baptism predates the L 10 civil duplicates (start 1810); not attempted. FS profile G921-V35 has no new sources.
researchLogEntry: Round 4: nothing new beyond mentions in the 1862 birth and 1867 death entries; birth year 1806/07 still unresolved.
